macros.name: breaklig
macros.doc: The macro \breaklig, which doesn’t take an argument, is provided as a hopefully easy-to-remember substitute for the lower-level LaTeX command “\-\hspace{0pt}”. You should insert this macro in places where you want to break up a ligature on an ad-hoc basis and also wish to permit hyphenation.

macros.name: debugoff
macros.doc: To terminate or suspend the writing of the debugging-related information to the .log file, execute the command \debugoff.

macros.name: debugon
macros.doc: If you execute the command \debugon, detailed information about each \nolig and \keeplig pattern match that is encountered is written to the .log file.

macros.name: selnoligoff
macros.doc: The directives \selnoligon and \selnoligoff, described in Section 6.4, turn on and switch off selnolig’s ligature-suppressing algorithms.

macros.name: selnoligon
macros.doc: The directives \selnoligon and \selnoligoff, described in Section 6.4, turn on and switch off selnolig’s ligature-suppressing algorithms.

macros.name: uselig
macros.doc: The selnolig package also provides the user command \uselig, which acts very much like the \keeplig command to override the action of a \nolig rule.
